query.text: 生活助手，请在我询问穿衣建议或天气相关问题时，及时为我解答。
query.text_en: Life assistant, please answer me promptly when I ask for clothing advice or weather-related questions.

annotation.text_zh: 外面下雨降温了，穿这件羽绒服刚好。
annotation.text_en: It's raining and getting colder outside, so this down jacket is perfect.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
